definitions.gloss: external medicine; topical medication; medication for external use
definitions.explanation: Any medicine applied to the outside of the body — ointments, creams, patches, eye drops, ear drops, etc. — as opposed to medicine taken internally.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外用薬|がいようやく}です。
examples.english: This medicine is for external use.

examples.japanese: {外用薬|がいようやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please apply the topical medication directly to the affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内服薬|ないふくやく}→内服薬：22643_naifukuyaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{外用薬|がいようやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{外用薬|がいようやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧⟦{塗布|とふ}→塗布：24594_tofu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧よう⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was prescribed both oral and topical medication, and was instructed to apply the topical one twice a day.

notes:
Compound of {外用|がいよう} ('external use') and {薬|やく} ('medicine'). The standard pharmaceutical term for any medication not taken by mouth or injection, including creams, ointments, patches, and drops.

USAGE:
- The label {外用|がいよう} appears on medicine packaging to indicate it should not be ingested
- Contrasts with ⟦{内服薬|ないふくやく}→内服薬：22643_naifukuyaku⟧ ('oral medication') and {注射薬|ちゅうしゃやく} ('injectable medication')
- Common in pharmacy, hospital, and product labeling contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外用薬|がいようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply topical medication
- {外用薬|がいようやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe external medication
- {外用薬|がいようやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用方法|しようほうほう}: how to use external medication
- ⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧{外用薬|がいようやく}: dermatological topical medication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内服薬|ないふくやく}→内服薬：22643_naifukuyaku⟧: oral medicine; internal medicine — medication taken by mouth
- ⟦{塗り薬|ぬりぐすり}→塗り薬：17374_nurigusuri⟧: ointment; cream — the everyday word for topical medicine you spread on skin
- {貼り薬|はりぐすり}: medicated patch — a specific type of external medicine applied as a patch
